meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin in India under ₹500**, my top pick is:

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser]()
*₹248*

### My shortlist

| Face wash | Current price* | Best for |
|---|---:|---|
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid** | ~₹248 | ⭐ Oily + clogged pores/acne |
| **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic + 2% Niacinamide** | ~₹224 | Oily + frequent breakouts |
| **Simple Refreshing Facial Gel Wash** | ~₹204 | Oily but sensitive skin |
| **Fixderma Salyzap** | ~₹266 | Oily + blackheads/whiteheads |
| **Dot & Key Cica + Salicylic Acid** | ~₹214 | Oily + acne-prone |


\*Prices vary by seller and offers. Current shopping results show these under ₹500. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**What I'd buy:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid. Salicylic acid is particularly useful for oily skin because it helps remove excess sebum and unclog pores. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If your skin is **very oily but not acne-prone**, I'd actually choose a gentler daily cleanser rather than using 2% salicylic acid twice every day.

If you tell me whether you have **acne/blackheads, sensitive skin, or just oily skin**, I can narrow it down to **one exact face wash**. 
